candidates.label: Quran as straight Book without deviance serving dual warning-tidings function

candidates.label: Closing prophetic identity: human receiving revelation commanding tawheed without association
candidates.definition: In 18:110: Say I only man like you revealed your god one God; whoever hopes meeting Lord do righteous worship associate none.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا وَلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدَۢا

candidates.label: Gardens of Paradise as eternal lodging without desire for transfer
candidates.definition: In 18:107-108: Believed righteous deeds have Gardens Paradise lodging; abide eternally not desiring transfer.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسِ نُزُلًا
